system.boundary: Build a three-phase shunt active power filter for a 50 Hz source feeding a nonlinear load.
physical_paths: The source and nonlinear load must connect at a common PCC, and a controllable three-phase converter with a split DC link must connect in shunt at that PCC.

At nominal conditions and throughout this envelope, the physical source current must be substantially less distorted than the nonlinear-load current, the measured currents must satisfy current balance at the PCC, the total DC-link voltage must remain about 1.16 kV, and the two DC-link halves must remain balanced.
functional_paths: The source and nonlinear load must connect at a common PCC, and a controllable three-phase converter with a split DC link must connect in shunt at that PCC.
The current compensation and split DC-link regulation must establish promptly after startup.
information_paths: R_nl -> D023 plant/control path -> Vac, Vdc, Iload, Isource, Icomp
modes_and_events: The current compensation and split DC-link regulation must establish promptly after startup.

interfaces.name: R_nl
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read R_nl from a base-workspace variable; its nominal value is 4 ohm and its operating envelope is +/-10%.

interfaces.name: Vac
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries Vac, Vdc, Iload, Isource and Icomp. Vdc must contain exactly the two positive rail-to-neutral half-link voltages, while Vac and all current outputs must contain exactly the three physical phases.
